notes.title: Optimization and Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you’re doing well.

Got an update here. Slightly improved load times, but greatly improved FPS. Fixed a graphical error at the end of the 'Septic Seas' chapter. Fixed an event not triggering in the 'Escape' level.

Have fun and have a great day! Thanks!

notes.title: HUNKENSTEIN!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730750/Hunkenstein/]Hunkenstein Steam Store Page![/url]

[b]Welcome to a world where movie monsters have become household pests.[/b] 

Built from the finest scratch parts by a thirsty mad-scientist, you'll find yourself alive again, tasked with monster-eradication. Stake, burn, detonate, shoot, or mulch your way through each infestation, then collect the check!

Utilize meat-magnets, net-launchers, anvil-cannons, giant glue-traps, fall-cages, flying pig-copters, and good old fashioned gasoline to exterminate an onslaught of physics based enemies. Ghouls, werewolves, vampires, zombies, killer-dolls, lake-creatures, mummies, and more.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Just released an update fixing a couple of notes that weren't displaying properly, as well as a glitch in the driving level. Performance should be a little better now as well. Thanks for playing!

HAPPY ALMOST NEW YEAR!

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a small update here, addressing a few issues.

Fixed two buggy cut-scenes near the end of the game as well as slightly improved performance.

Thanks! Stay Safe!

notes.title: A.D.I.T.D. v1.2
notes.notes: Hey everyone! We've posted an update to address a few small bug fixes as well as added in some new SFX. Working on some additional content right now, so stay tuned! Thanks for playing, and please report any bugs in the discussions if you will. Thanks!

notes.title: A.D.I.T.D. v1.1
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We’ve got achievements out now, as well as some performance updates and audio improvements/rebalances. Hope you’re enjoying the game. If you encounter any bugs or anything of the sort, please add them in the discussions if you will. Thanks!

notes.title: A Full Moon Rises...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today, we have fully released…A Dump in the Dark! After two years we have finally finished our first game! A year in Early Access has taught us a lot about this industry and the awesomeness of this platform and the freedoms it allows. 

For any fledgling devs out there like us wondering: Early Access was a fantastic experience, and the ability to have direct feedback about what’s right or wrong about your game was so incredibly helpful. Thank you so much to everyone who took the time to message us, and leave feedback on how they felt, pointing us in the direction of bugs and sharp edges. You are true saints, Thank You. 

We’re still working on subtitles and achievements, and optimizing anything we can. We have hunted down every bug we could find, and we have reached a point that seems worthy to leave the warm, caring womb of Early Access. If anyone encounters any bugs, or strangeness of any sort, please report them in the discussions if you will, and they will be terminated promptly. Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the game!

P.S. If you bought this game, you're a freak...but we love you anyway!

notes.title: From the Moist Darkness, into the Frothy Light
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! In the last couple weeks we’ve added most of the final touches to our tale, and we’re looking forward to the final…quivering release. It’s been a filthy, enjoyable journey for us, and we hope you have enjoyed yourselves as well. 

We’re going to use the rest of our time in early access to polish and optimize, and soon this tale will be over…

Thanks and blessings to everyone who helped get us greenlit, and supported us along the way! May your cheeks always remain cheery and rosy!

notes.title: This Halloween, Clench Tight...
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We've got some major performance and graphics updates for you, updated cheeks, as well as a new dump type: wonderful, sloshy diarrhea for the whole family to enjoy! Just hit ‘V’ for violent bursts of goodness. We’ve got a huge load of story content on the way that needs a little more time to digest. In the mean-time, we hope you enjoy, and have a Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Voyage for Booty in the Latest Chapter!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We hope you’re enjoying the game, and thanks for your patronage in this time of miracles. Today we released a patch with the latest chapter, “Voyage on Septic Seas”, along with many optimizations and fixes, and an improved chapter select system. Special thanks to everyone who has left feedback pointing us in the direction of bugs and areas that need improvement. We hope you enjoy the new chapter, where you will delve into the mysterious past of America’s favorite tasty treat! They’re the Tiny People You Can Eat!

Also we’re releasing trading cards today! God bless us, everyone.

notes.title: The Asscension Begins
notes.notes:
Hey, all! We’ve just released an update with several tune-ups, plus the newest chapter, "Incorporeal Asscension". It comes complete with new rump-punishing enemies, mechanics, and more Gribbles than your small intestines can handle. 

Also, starting later today, A Dump in the Dark will be on sale!
